definitions.explanation: The clipped form of {月曜日|げつようび}, used where the day is already understood as a day of the week — schedules, timetables, calendars, and casual speech.

examples.japanese: {月曜|げつよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧です。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月曜|げつよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting was moved to Monday morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月曜|げつよう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金曜|きんよう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is open from Monday through Friday.

notes:
Shortened from ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧ by dropping {日|び}. The full form is the default in careful speech and writing; the short form appears where space is tight or the context is obvious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月曜|げつよう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金曜|きんよう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from Monday to Friday
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{月曜|げつよう}: every Monday
- {月曜|げつよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: Monday morning
- ⟦{隔週|かくしゅう}→隔週：15282_kakushuu⟧{月曜|げつよう}: every other Monday

USAGE:
All seven days clip the same way (⟦{火曜|かよう}→火曜：13459_kayou⟧, ⟦{水曜|すいよう}→水曜：30304_suiyou⟧, ⟦{木曜|もくよう}→木曜：03163_mokuyou⟧, {金曜|きんよう}, ⟦{土曜|どよう}→土曜：22529_doyou⟧, ⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧). In tables and signs the reading is often abbreviated further to the single kanji {月|げつ}.
